title: Data Modeling on Databricks: Medallion Architecture to Star Schema (Free Edition)
requirements: Databricks Free Edition workspace with a cluster
Create catalog 'datamodelling' with bronze, silver and gold schemas
Run the notebooks in order: Source -> Bronze -> Silver -> Gold
diagram:
graph LR
  S[Source: raw dataset] --> B[Bronze: raw ingest Delta]
  B --> SI[Silver: clean + standardize]
  SI --> G[Gold: Star Schema]
  G --> FS[fact_sales]
  G --> D1[dim_customer]
  G --> D2[dim_products]
  G --> D3[dim_payments]
  G --> D4[dim_regions]
  G --> D5[dim_sales]
preview: Build a full medallion pipeline (Source -> Bronze -> Silver -> Gold) in Databricks Free Edition that lands in a star schema: fact_sales plus 5 dimensions, with surrogate keys generated via ROW_NUMBER() window functions in Spark SQL.
portfolio_value: Clean, self-contained reference for a DA migrating to Databricks: shows the canonical medallion-to-star-schema flow with Delta Lake on Unity Catalog, no cloud account required. Includes a Star Schema diagram for the README.
notes: Based on an Ansh Lamba tutorial. Gold notebook builds DimCustomer/DimProducts/DimPayment/DimRegions/DimSales + fact via DISTINCT + ROW_NUMBER surrogate keys. All Spark SQL (%sql). Ships Star Schema.png and Medallion Architecture.png. Branch: main.

title: Retail Orders End-to-End on Azure Databricks: ADF + DLT Medallion to Power BI
requirements: Azure subscription with Data Factory and Data Lake Storage Gen2
Databricks workspace; import the retail_orders.dbc archive
Configure ADLS Gen2 and GitHub connectors for ingestion
Power BI to consume the Gold layer
diagram:
graph LR
  GH[GitHub source] --> ADF[Azure Data Factory]
  ADF --> ADLS[ADLS Gen2 raw]
  ADLS --> L[Lookup load]
  L --> BR[Bronze: AutoLoader ingest]
  BR --> SI[Silver: Customers/Orders/Products/Regions]
  SI --> GO[Gold: dims + Fact_Orders star schema]
  GO --> PBI[Power BI reports]
solution_loc: asset/retail_orders.dbc (Databricks archive: lookup, Bronze, Silver_*, Gold_* notebooks)
preview: End-to-end Azure pipeline: ADF ingests retail order data from GitHub into ADLS Gen2, then Databricks Delta Live Tables build a Bronze (AutoLoader) -> Silver -> Gold medallion flow ending in a Fact_Orders star schema served to Power BI.
portfolio_value: Most cloud-realistic of the set for a DA/DE: full Azure orchestration (ADF + ADLS Gen2 + Databricks DLT + Power BI). Demonstrates AutoLoader incremental ingest and a productionized dim/fact star schema feeding BI.
notes: Solution code shipped as a binary .dbc archive (asset/retail_orders.dbc) plus parquet sample datasets under asset/dataset. Architecture and workflow PNGs included. Notebooks named lookup/Bronze/Silver_Customers/Silver_Orders/Silver_Products/Silver_Regions/Gold_Customers/Gold_Products/Gold Orders. Branch: main.

title: Bronze-to-Gold Dimensional Model in Power BI / Microsoft Fabric Style
requirements: Power BI Desktop to open the .pbit template
Provide/refresh the CSV sales dataset for the Bronze load
diagram:
graph LR
  CSV[CSV sales dataset] --> BR[Bronze: Power BI raw load]
  BR --> SI[Silver: Power Query clean/transform]
  SI --> GO[Gold: Star Schema semantic model]
  GO --> FS[Fact Sales]
  GO --> D1[Dim Customer]
  GO --> D2[Dim Product]
  GO --> D3[Dim Geography]
  GO --> D4[Dim Category]
  GO --> D5[Dim Date]
  GO --> DAX[DAX measures + time intelligence]
  DAX --> DB[Power BI dashboards]
solution_loc: Data Modeling Project.pbit (Power BI template: Power Query model + DAX semantic model)
preview: Design an enterprise-grade Power BI semantic model that maps the medallion architecture (Bronze raw load -> Silver Power Query -> Gold star schema) onto a Microsoft Fabric flow, then layer DAX time intelligence, Top-N and budget-vs-forecast analytics over Fact Sales + 5 dimensions.
portfolio_value: Pure modeling + BI value for a DA: surrogate keys, relationship optimization, time-intelligence DAX and dashboard storytelling, framed as a Fabric-style architecture. Strongest piece for showing analytical/semantic-layer skill rather than pipeline engineering.
notes: Solution shipped as a .pbit template plus an Executive Summary dashboard PNG. Fabric is conceptual mapping (CSV->Power Query->Semantic Model->DAX->Power BI), not actual Fabric lakehouse. Star schema: Fact Sales + Dim Customer/Product/Geography/Category/Date. Branch: main.

title: Advanced SQL Data Warehouse: ERP+CRM Medallion ETL, Star Schema and EDA Analytics
requirements: Run 00_init_database, then bronze/silver load procs, then gold DDL
Load ERP + CRM source CSVs from row_dataset/
diagram:
graph LR
  ERP[ERP CSVs] --> BR[Bronze: raw load proc]
  CRM[CRM CSVs] --> BR
  BR --> SI[Silver: clean + harmonize proc]
  SI --> GO[Gold: views fact_sales + dims]
  GO --> FS[gold.fact_sales]
  GO --> DC[gold.dim_customers]
  GO --> DP[gold.dim_products]
  GO --> EDA[EDA + advanced analytics scripts]
  EDA --> RC[report_customers]
  EDA --> RP[report_products]
preview: A pure-SQL, end-to-end retail data warehouse: integrate ERP+CRM sources through a Bronze->Silver->Gold medallion ETL (stored procedures), model a star schema (fact_sales + dim_customers/dim_products as Gold views), then run 12 advanced EDA/analytics scripts producing customer and product KPI reports.
portfolio_value: Best for proving deep analytical SQL without Databricks: ranking, segmentation, cumulative trends, change-over-time, part-to-whole and KPI reports (VIP/Regular/New segments, AOV, recency, monthly spend). The dimensional modeling and window-function analytics transfer directly to Databricks SQL.
notes: PostgreSQL / advanced SQL, no Databricks. Gold layer built as VIEWS over Silver with ROW_NUMBER surrogate keys; dim_customers joins CRM cust_info + ERP cust_az12 + loc_a101. Ships quality_checks_silver/gold tests, data_catalog.md, naming_conventions.md, architecture/data_model PNGs and gold.*.csv outputs. MIT licensed, synthetic data. Branch: main.
